A '''wooden shovel''' is a [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from one plank and two sticks.

=== Crafting ===

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It keeps the vanilla mining speed of 2 but has {{Value|Wooden Shovel|durability}} durability instead of 59.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Shovel|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Shovel|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
